0022600132.text: Atlanta hosts Miami in the Hawks' fifth game of the 2026-27 season, and they sit at 2-2 overall, 2-1 on the road and 0-1 at home, seventh in the East and second in the Southeast, one game back. The Heat, 0-4 on a four-game losing streak, are 0-3 at home and rank 15th in the East and fifth in the Southeast, three games back. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and the teams have not met yet this season, after the Hawks lost 1-3 in the 2025-26 series, including a 143-117 defeat in Miami on April 12, 2026.
